title: Mobile validation server exposed on LAN
locator: cd jossue-portfolio && npx astro dev stop; npx astro dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4321 --background; curl -I http://127.0.0.1:4321/es/; curl -I http://192.168.100.110:4321/es/; lsof -nP -iTCP:4321 -sTCP:LISTEN
result: PASS: restarted Astro background dev server for jossue-portfolio on port 4321 with host 0.0.0.0. Astro status reports Network URL http://192.168.100.110:4321/. HTTP HEAD returned 200 OK for http://127.0.0.1:4321/es/ and http://192.168.100.110:4321/es/. lsof shows node pid 25042 listening on TCP *:4321.
limitations: Requires mobile device to be on the same Wi-Fi/LAN as this Mac. Firewall or network isolation may block access from the phone even though local LAN HTTP checks pass.
